Political satire is fast approaching a dead end.

It is becoming increasingly difficult to lampoon the left, as they have become masters of lampooning themselves.

For someone who makes their hay on this app by mocking my political opponents, their decline into madness has become worrisome, albeit for very selfish reasons.

Shitposters such as myself operate in the gray area between reality and the outright absurd. It is here that we plant and harvest our little memes and clapbacks that have come to define online discourse.

But these days that fertile acreage has been decimated by the libs’ increasingly cartoonish behavior; the line between comedy and reality has beside blurred beyond distinction.

Consider that we are only a few years beyond the Me Too movement and woman-groping weirdo Pedro Pascal is now considered a leftist hero while successful model and actress Sydney Sweeney is dubbed a Nazi for wearing denim.

Or that a segment of the gay community believes they would be welcomed with open arms by Gazans.

Or that Jasmine Crockett exists.

I mean, what witty one-liners can possibly top these actual events?

This is literally how every DevOps conversation starts:

Developer: “It works on my machine.”

DevOps: “Then we’ll ship your machine.”

Docker: “Say less.” 🐳

And that’s not even a joke.

That’s the exact problem Docker solved.
- Same code.
- Same dependencies.
- Same environment.
- Everywhere.

No more:
“but it worked locally." 

Drop a 🐳 if you’ve been on either side of this conversation.
